summary: @ornikar/eslint-config-formatjs preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares a `preinstall: node setup.mjs` lifecycle hook. setup.mjs detects the host platform, downloads a pinned Bun binary from oven-sh's GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is roughly 727KB of obfuscator.io-style output — a large numeric string array combined with a rotation function (`WV8StW`) and `_0xXXXX`-style identifiers — that cannot be statically inspected. The package's declared purpose is an ESLint / formatjs configuration, which has no need to pull a second JavaScript runtime at install time to execute an opaque bundle. The dropper pattern (alternate-runtime download + install-time execution of an obfuscated sibling file whose contents are unrelated to the advertised purpose) hands full code execution to whatever math_init.js contains on every `npm install` of this package. The `@ornikar` scope also suggests a typosquat / lookalike of the legitimate Ornikar organization's tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
